problems.negative_net: Deductions are more than the pay. Lower a deduction or add an earning.
problems.no_salary: No salary for this month. Set the salary, then calculate again.

runs.title: Payroll
runs.text: Each month's salaries: calculate, check, send for approval and pay.
runs.opened: {month} started. Calculate it to see everyone's pay.
runs.empty_text: Start a month to work out everyone's salary from their pay and attendance.

run.no_slips: Nobody yet. Press Calculate to work out the slips.
run.needs_calculation: Not calculated yet. Press Calculate after salaries and attendance are ready; you can calculate again any time before sending.
run.no_adjustments: None this month. Add a bonus, an arrear or a deduction here, then calculate again.
run.adjusted: Added. Calculate again to see it on the slip.
run.label: Shown on the slip as
run.label_hint: e.g. Eid bonus, Arrear for June
run.bad_amount: Write an amount above zero, like 1500 or 1500.50.
run.pay_text: Mark {amount} as paid to everyone after the bank or wallet transfer is done.

done.reject: Sent back to the payroll team.

confirm.submit_text: Net pay {amount}. Nothing can change while it is waiting; an approver can send it back.
confirm.approve_text: Net pay {amount}. Approve only after checking the slips. Your name is recorded.
confirm.reject_text: Say what must change. The payroll team sees your reason.
confirm.delete_text: The draft and its slips go. You can start the month again.

bank.done: Bank file saved. Keep it safe: it has full account numbers.
bank.missing: Bank file saved. {count} people have no account and must be paid another way.

slip.title: Payslip
slip.footer: This payslip was made by the payroll system and needs no signature.

employees.title: Salaries
employees.text: Everyone's salary today and how they are paid.
employees.missing: {count} people have no salary. They will show as a problem in the month's payroll.
employees.empty_text: Employees added in HR appear here.

pay.text: Salary history and where pay goes.
pay.change_salary_text: The new salary starts on the day you choose; the one before ends the day before.
pay.no_payment: Not set. Without it this person is left out of the bank file.
pay.number_kept: On file: {masked}. Leave empty to keep it.

components.title: Pay components
components.text: The parts of a salary: house rent, medical, transport, provident fund and so on.
components.empty_text: Add the allowances and deductions your salaries are made of.
components.prorate: Cut for days not worked (joining, leaving, absence)

structures.title: Pay structures
structures.text: Ready-made salary shapes. Each gives the basic and the components on top of it.
structures.empty_text: Make one for each kind of staff, like Officer or Worker.
structures.items_hint: Each one is a fixed amount or a percentage of the basic.
structures.bad_value: Write an amount (like 1500) or a percentage (like 50).

mine.title: My payslips
mine.empty_text: Your payslip appears here once the month's payroll is approved.

loans.title: Loans and advances
loans.text: Money lent to staff, recovered from their salary month by month.
loans.ask_text: Another person approves it before the money is paid out.
loans.empty_text: Loans and salary advances you give staff appear here with what is left to recover.
loans.needs_approval: Nothing is paid out or recovered until someone else approves it.

loan.schedule_text: Recovered with each approved payroll; a month can be held back while its payroll is a draft.
loan.skip_text: Nothing is recovered that month; the loan takes a month longer. Say why.
loan.skipped: {month} held back. Calculate that month again.
loan.unskipped: {month} will be recovered again. Calculate that month again.

done.approve: Approved. Recovery starts with its first month.

confirm.approve_text: {amount} is paid out and recovered from the salary. Your name is recorded.
confirm.reject_text: Say why; payroll staff see your reason.
confirm.cancel_text: The request for {amount} is closed. You can ask again.

bonuses.title: Festival bonuses
bonuses.text: Eid, Puja and other bonuses, paid apart from the monthly salary.
bonuses.opened: Bonus opened. Calculate it to see who gets what.
bonuses.empty_text: Open a bonus for a festival; everyone employed that day gets a line.
bonuses.name: Name
bonuses.bonus_on_hint: Service is counted up to this day.

bonus.needs_calculation: Not calculated yet. Calculate to see who gets the bonus; you can calculate again any time before sending.
bonus.change_text: Leave the person out, or set an amount by hand (it counts even with short service).
